title: Service Account Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As a Services Account Manager, you will manage assigned customer service requests and issues from initial quotation through to delivery and issue resolution. Your role ensures a seamless, high\-quality customer experience across the full service lifecycle for the requests and accounts assigned to you. Your responsibilities include:
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Managing assigned customer service requests end\-to\-end — from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment, delivery, and issue closure.
* Preparing and issuing accurate, timely quotations in response to assigned service requests, ensuring alignment with technical and commercial requirements.
* Managing the Inquiry to Order (ITO) process for assigned requests, including coordinating commercial and contractual details with internal stakeholders (engineering, operations, logistics, finance).
* Tracking assigned service requests and orders to ensure timely delivery, proactively communicating status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinating with internal teams (engineering, field service, supply chain) to resolve assigned customer issues, escalations, and technical queries efficiently.
* Ensuring service excellence by monitoring resolution times, quality, and customer satisfaction for assigned requests.
* Communicating clearly with customers throughout the lifecycle of assigned requests, setting expectations and managing follow\-ups.
* Identifying recurring issues or service gaps within assigned accounts and escalating/collaborating with relevant teams (Marketing, Product Line, Engineering) to drive improvement.
* Applying Six Sigma analytical tools, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), to support resolution of reliability issues and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.
* Maintaining accurate records of service requests, interactions, and resolutions within CRM/ERP systems.
* Supporting strong working relationships with customers on assigned requests to promote satisfaction and repeat engagement.
* Regularly reporting to the APAC Services Operations Manager on assigned request status, open issues, and service delivery performance.
* Staying informed on customer needs, product/service requirements, and regional market conditions relevant to assigned accounts.
* Collaborating with the Services Product Line team to relay customer feedback and support development of new/improved service offerings.
* If you are a detail\-oriented, technically proficient professional passionate about delivering exceptional customer service in the Power Conversion sector across India/APAC, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity with GE Power Conversion.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college/university in Electrical Engineering or allied Engineering discipline. (Master's degree a plus.)
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in customer service, account management, technical support, or service operations.
* Offshore industry experience and process knowledge in one or more of: Metal, Marine, Oil \& Gas, Test Bench, Material Handling, or Power Plant sectors.
* Knowledge of Power Electronics, High Voltage Equipment, and PLC systems.
* Experience with quotation preparation and ITO (Inquiry to Order) processes.
* Willingness to travel across India/APAC region as required.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Prior experience with MV/LV drives, industrial automation systems, and large motors and generators.
* Proficient in both oral and written communication in English (additional regional languages a plus).
* Strong organizational and follow\-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent service requests.
* Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on responsiveness and issue resolution.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, field service, and supply chain teams.
* Proactive problem\-solver, comfortable working in high\-pressure, matrix\-based environments.
* Experience with CRM/ERP systems for tracking service requests and orders.
* Demonstrated technical proficiency coupled with strong customer service orientation


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Delivery Lead
 



**Location:** 
 Only Chennai\- Hybrid(4 days/week). Not open for other locations at this point
 



**Duration:** 
 Full time
 



**Notice period:** 
 Immediate to 60 days max
 



**Budget:** 
 Open to discuss
 



  





 ⚠️ Important Note
 



**Please do not apply if you have interviewed with Mastech Digital within the past 3 months.** 
 Duplicate/recent interview profiles may not be considered for this opportunity.
 



  





  





**Role Summary** 




*The Delivery Lead (known as Delivery Manager in other organizations) sits between the Delivery Partner and Project Manager in the delivery hierarchy — owning end\-to\-end delivery of Data \& Analytics programs for one or more client accounts, depending on account size, and ensuring governance, quality, and strong client stakeholder relationships. This is a generic role deployed across verticals; specific vertical experience is a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement.* 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of D\&A programs for one or more client accounts, scaling scope with account size and complexity
* Drive program planning, execution tracking, and milestone management across owned accounts
* Embed standardized delivery and automation practices across each account



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the primary client\-facing point of contact for delivery matters on owned accounts
* Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and proactively manage expectations
* Lead delivery governance forums (status reviews, steering committees) with client leadership



  





**Governance, Quality \& Risk** 



* Ensure delivery governance and quality standards are met across engagements
* Proactively identify delivery risks and drive mitigation and escalation as needed
* Deliver scalable, insight\-driven solutions aligned to client business outcomes



  





**Team \& Project Management Oversight** 



* Direct and mentor Project Managers/project leads within owned accounts, providing delivery direction beyond single\-project execution
* Manage delivery estimation, staffing, and financial performance for assigned accounts
* Track utilization, billing milestones, and margin across owned accounts
* Escalate portfolio\-level risks, resourcing gaps, or growth opportunities to the Delivery Partner where applicable



  





**Must\-Have Skills \& Experience** 



* Strong delivery management experience on analytics/D\&A projects
* Client\-facing experience with senior stakeholders
* Working knowledge of cloud data ecosystems (AWS/Azure/GCP data platforms)
* Solid grounding in delivery governance, estimation, and financial management
* Demonstrated hands\-on delivery ownership, not just program oversight
* Experience directing or mentoring Project Managers, or a track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams/accounts



  





**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Domain experience in Financial Services \& Payments (FSP) — e.g., SOX, PCI\-DSS, Basel, banking/payments data ecosystems — is a plus
* Domain experience in Healthcare — e.g., HIPAA, HL7/FHIR, payer/provider analytics — is a plus
* Domain experience in Retail — e.g., merchandising, supply chain, or customer/loyalty analytics — is a plus
* Domain experience in Manufacturing — e.g., Industry 4\.0, IoT/OT data, supply chain or quality analytics — is a plus
* PMP, Agile/Scrum, or Scaled Agile (SAFe) certification
* Relevant cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP data or analytics track)
* Experience with delivery reporting/tooling (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, Tableau)



  





**Education \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field
* 12–18 years of overall experience, including meaningful experience managing and delivering analytics/D\&A projects, with hands\-on client\-facing delivery ownership



  





**Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months** 



* Strong client relationship established; delivery predictability visibly improved
* Account governance cadences (steering committee, status reporting) fully operational
* Standardized delivery practices and playbooks embedded across owned account(s)



  





**\*\*\*Profiles We Are Not looking at This Point\*\*\*** 



* Pure PMO or BI\-developer profiles without delivery ownership
* Profiles without hands\-on delivery ownership or client interfacing experience
* No prior exposure to Data \& Analytics engagements

title: Assistant Manager - Customer Support (Chennai Parts Distribution Centre)
description:

title: Principal CX Advisory Consultant
description:
**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

 The
 **CX Advisory Consultant** 
 is responsible for supporting strategic Genesys customers across the
 **APAC region** 
 through Customer Experience (CX) Advisory engagements. The role acts as a bridge between
 **Genesys and the customer’s CX strategy and stakeholders** 
 , ensuring alignment between business goals, digital transformation objectives, and successful adoption of Genesys solutions.
   

  

 This position combines
 **business consulting expertise** 
 ,
 **CX strategy experience** 
 , and
 **change management capability** 
 to help customers define, implement, and sustain world\-class customer experiences. The CX Advisory Consultant partners closely with customer executives, operational teams, and Genesys stakeholders to identify opportunities, design solutions, and guide organizations through transformation that delivers measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities include (but not limited to):**
* Partner with strategic customers to identify, assess, and prioritize CX challenges and opportunities across CX, digital, and contact center operations.
* Analyze business processes and recommend improvements that enhance customer journeys and business performance.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to create and deliver CX transformation roadmaps aligned with business strategy and technology capabilities.
* Develop functional designs that translate business requirements into customer journey flows and operational configurations.
* Lead and support change management and adoption programs, including communication, training, and coaching strategies to ensure successful transformation.
* Leverage analytics to measure adoption, operational efficiency, and CX outcomes, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with customer executives, partners, and internal Genesys teams; lead workshops, executive briefings, and strategic engagements.
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and lessons learned to ensure consistent delivery excellence and customer success.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in CX consulting, digital transformation, or contact center operations.
* Minimum of 3\+ years’ experience working as a consultant within CX, Digital, Reporting \& Analytics, or Contact Center Operations, with demonstrated ability to advise on appropriate business and operational solutions.
* 3\+ years’ experience leading large\-scale projects or programs that deliver measurable business change in CX, Digital, or Operational Transformation.
* Strong knowledge of contact center operations, including KPIs/metrics, industry best practices, employee experience, and technology enablement.
* Proven excellence in customer\-facing roles, including leading workshops, building and delivering high\-quality presentations, and engaging effectively with stakeholders up to C\-level.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both business and technical audiences.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies (user stories, epics, product demos, sprint planning, and execution).
* Strong analytical and creative problem\-solving skills in complex customer environments.
* Experience with Genesys Cloud or other leading CX platforms is highly desirable.


**Work Context:**
* Frequent interaction with customers, cross\-functional Genesys teams, and external partners.
* Regular use of digital collaboration tools and business systems.
* Travel within the APAC region (up to 30%) for customer meetings and strategic engagements.

title: ServiceNow CSM - Senior Consultant
description:

 : Senior Consultant or equivalent

* Experience with CSM data models, case lifecycle management, workflows, and portal capabilities

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager

**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**

Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Business Descriptor**
 International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high\-net\-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Grow profit and portfolio value across Premier client relationships through new and existing business
* Deliver agreed financial targets through effective relationship management and consistent service delivery
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services
* Identify wealth review opportunities and provide tailored wealth solutions aligned to customer goals
* Build long\-term client relationships that improve retention satisfaction and wallet share
* Maintain accurate client information using client relationship management tools and disciplined record keeping
* Manage a prospect pipeline and apply structured plans to deepen and expand relationships
* Embed HSBC policies and controls including KYC AML and sanctions alongside sales quality requirements


**Eligibility \& Educational Qualifications**
* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4\-7 years of relevant experience
* Substantial experience as a Relationship Manager within the Retail or Premier Banking segment
* Proven outcomes in wealth products with a record of meeting portfolio and revenue goals

**Additional Notes**

You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Advisory Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 The Advisory Account Manager (AAM) is a dual\-mandate, portfolio\-owning role. Unlike a traditional CSM or a pure hunter\-AM, the AAM operates as a trusted advisor across the full customer lifecycle — responsible simultaneously for protecting Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and driving Net Expansion through upsell and cross\-sell. This is a digital\-first, high\-velocity motion that blends proactive advisory engagement with a disciplined, data\-driven approach to identifying both risk and opportunity across the assigned book.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own an assigned portfolio of accounts end\-to\-end, accountable for both renewal/retention (GRR) and expansion outcomes across the book.
* Proactively engage customers using the tiered digital engagement model (tech\-touch, low\-touch, and 1:many plays based on segment and risk/opportunity signal).
* Build and execute account\-level Customer Success Plans that identify whitespace for upsell/cross\-sell and flag early indicators of churn or contraction risk.
* Run consultative value conversations with key stakeholders — demonstrating ROI, product adoption gains, and business outcomes tied to the Freshworks suite.
* Drive expansion revenue through upsell (higher tiers, additional seats) and cross\-sell (adjacent Freshworks products) to meet or exceed a blended revenue target.
* Identify at\-risk accounts early using health scores, usage data, and engagement signals; build and execute save plans in partnership with Support, Billing, and Deal Desk.
* Maintain deep product fluency across the Freshworks suite to run demos, map use cases, and recommend the best\-fit solution for a customer's problem.
* Use the customer success platform to track account health, adoption metrics, and pipeline, and to report portfolio status on a defined cadence.
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Renewals, Sales, Support, and Product Marketing to remove friction across the customer journey.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene for both the expansion and renewal book.
* Adhere to Freshworks compliance and information security processes in all customer\-facing activity.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistent attainment against a blended quota comprising Net Expansion (upsell/cross\-sell bookings) and Gross Revenue Retention (renewal/anti\-churn).
* Improving product adoption and account health scores across the assigned portfolio.
* A portfolio where expansion is proactively sourced — not just reactive to inbound demand — while renewal risk is caught and mitigated well ahead of the renewal date.


**Qualifications**
* 3–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or SaaS sales, with direct experience carrying both a retention and an expansion/upsell number.
* Demonstrated track record of account growth (upsell/cross\-sell) alongside strong renewal/retention performance — not one at the expense of the other.
* Consultative approach: comfortable building business cases, ROI narratives, and stakeholder\-mapped account plans.
* Experience managing a digital\-first portfolio at scale, using tech\-touch and low\-touch cadences alongside targeted 1:1 engagement.
* Working knowledge of SaaS retention/expansion metrics — GRR, NRR, churn, expansion ARR, adoption.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical/product concepts for varying stakeholder levels (ESSENTIAL).
* Comfort working with CRM and customer success tooling for health scoring, forecasting, and reporting.
* Self\-starter, organized, and able to prioritize across a large book without losing attention to at\-risk or high\-potential accounts.


 Bachelor's degree required; Business or Computer Science background preferred
   

  

**Additional Information**
 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Provider Management Specialist
description:
**About Amplify Health**




**Who We Are** 




 Amplify Health is Asia’s leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region.
 



  





 We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS\-based products, PaaS\-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS\-based on\-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value\-chain.
 



  





 Our joint\-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match.
 



  





 We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes.
 



  





**Our Vision and Ambition** 




 To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.
 



 Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value\-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.
 



 By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health\-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.
 



  





**The Position**




**Summary** 




 As a Provider Management Specialist, the role is a specialist advisor position supporting private health insurers to improve their claims risk management, primarily through provider contracting strategy, panel optimisation, patient pathway design, and insurance product alignment.
 



 You will work directly with client teams, enabling them to build stronger provider networks, negotiate effectively, utilise data insights, and apply best‑practice provider management strategies within the healthcare and HealthTech ecosystem.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\) On‑Site Client Advisory \& Provider Management Support** 



* Serves as the primary advisor to senior insurer stakeholders to drive and support provider management targets, initiatives and implementations, including, supporting strategic initiatives, contracting cycles, and provider engagement plans.
* Shapes multi‑year provider strategy, including contracting redesign and ecosystem partnerships.
* Develop high‑quality materials for client prep sessions, executive updates, and provider negotiations, ensuring clarity, coherence and insight‑driven storytelling.
* Serve as an embedded advisor supporting the client’s operational and strategic objectives.



**2\) Internal Provider Analytics Product Development** 



* Translate key client needs, pain points, and market insights into product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback to evolve Amplify Health’s provider analytics tools, dashboards and negotiation support solutions.
* Acts as the thought partner to product leadership for long‑term roadmap development.



**3\) Capability Building and Upskilling Client Teams** 



* Identify and prioritize key knowledge gaps and design tailored workshops, demos and training modules to upskill capabilities across client teams.
* Run coaching and role‑play sessions to elevate client teams’ provider negotiation capabilities and commercial acumen to improve negotiations for provider engagements.



  





**Candidate Profile**




**Experience and Qualifications** 



* Over 6 years experience in health insurance, health\-related industries or consulting.
* Demonstrated success in managing cost efficiencies in healthcare, whether at providers, insurers or population health level.
* Proven experience in client advisory work particularly in healthcare related work.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or relevant) strongly preferred.



  





**Competencies \& Core Characteristics:** 




 We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale\-up environment:
 


* **Strategic Architect:** 
 Able to connect disparate information into a cohesive strategy leveraging Amplify Health frameworks. Capable of designing clear, actionable paths for clients navigating complex provider ecosystems.
* **Data\-Driven Decisiveness:** 
 Confidence in working with data, identifying insights, and translating analytics into compelling narratives. Ensures objective, evidence‑based decision‑making in provider negotiations and strategy formulation.
* **Customer‑Obsessed Advocate:** 
 Anticipates client needs and proactively delivers value through insights, structure and advisory support.
* **Resilient Operator:** 
 able to operate in a fluid and changing start\-up environment, flexing between internal work and client facing modes
* **Unifier \& Cross\-Functional Influencer:** 
 Collaborates seamlessly across clinical, analytics, commercial and product teams. Drives alignment and shared understanding between stakeholders.

title: Asset Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





**Manage the complete banking requirements of SME and corporate clients, including working capital, term loans, trade finance, foreign exchange, cash management, transaction banking and liability products, while identifying opportunities for cross\-selling and deepening client relationships.** 




 The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, advising and managing business banking relationships across working capital, trade finance, term lending, supply chain finance, export finance, business\-purpose mortgages, and insurance cross\-sell \- syndicated across BlissMoney’s panel of banks and NBFCs.
 



**1\. Products \& Services You Will Manage** 




  





**1\.1   Working Capital Finance** 




 ·       Cash Credit, Overdraft, Working Capital Demand Loans (WCDL), Dropline Overdraft, Short\-term loans and ad\-hoc limits
 



**1\.2   Trade Finance** 




 ·       Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Bill Discounting, Buyer’s Credit, Supplier’s Credit, Packing Credit, Post\-Shipment Finance, Export Bill Negotiation, Import Finance, Supply Chain Finance
 



**1\.3   Term Lending** 




 ·       Business Loans, Machinery / Equipment Finance, Commercial Property Loans, Capex Funding
 



**1\.4   Supply Chain \& Receivables Finance** 




 ·       Dealer Finance, Vendor Finance, Invoice Discounting, Factoring, Channel Finance
 



**1\.5 Export \& International Trade Finance** 





 ·       
 
**FCNR Funding:** 

 foreign\-currency funding sourced against FCNR(B) deposit\-linked facilities.
 





 ·       
 
**PCFC (Packing Credit in Foreign Currency):** 

 pre\-shipment export finance in foreign currency, complementing rupee\-denominated Packing Credit above.
 





 ·       
 
**EEFC Account\-Linked Facilities:** 

 supporting exporters who retain a portion of earnings in foreign currency.
 





 ·       
 
**Forfaiting:** 

 non\-recourse purchase of export receivables, distinct from and complementary to factoring.
 





 ·       
 
**Standby Letters of Credit (SBLC):** 

 for clients with cross\-border trade or contractual guarantee requirements.
 





 ·       
 
**External Commercial Borrowings (ECB) Facilitation:** 

 for larger export/import\-oriented clients seeking foreign currency term funding.
 




 ·       
 **ECGC\-Backed Export Credit Insurance:** 

 insurance
 
 \-supported export credit for clients trading in higher\-risk markets.
 



**1\.6 Business\-Purpose Mortgages** 




 ·       Loan Against Property (LAP) \- primarily for business owners raising capital against commercial or personal property.
 



**1\.7 Insurance Cross\-Sell** 





 ·       
 
**Loan Protection Insurance:** 

 bundled with any loan closed, tying directly into BlissMoney’s existing insurance services.
 





 ·       
 
**MSME / SME Insurance Products:** 

 broader business insurance \- property, liability, and other MSME\-relevant covers \- offered as a cross\-sell alongside lending, not limited to loan protection alone.
 




**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




  





**2\.1 Sourcing Business Banking Relationships** 




 ·       Build a pipeline of SME and corporate clients across working capital, trade finance, term lending and export finance needs \- leveraging existing banking relationships plus BlissMoney’s referral network.
 



 ·       Work leads handed over by the Wealth/RM team and existing client base.
 



**2\.2 Credit Assessment \& Structuring** 




 ·       Assess each client’s working capital cycle, trade flows, and credit need \- structuring a proposal a lender will actually approve.
 



 ·       For trade finance specifically: correctly structure LC, BG and documentary credit requirements, with working knowledge of INCOTERMS and export/import documentation.
 



**2\.3 Syndication \& Placement** 




 ·       Place the structured requirement with the right lender from BlissMoney’s panel of banks/NBFCs, based on rate, turnaround time, and eligibility fit.
 



 ·       For larger or foreign\-currency requirements, structure the facility across more than one lender where needed \- true syndication, not just referral.
 



**2\.4 Lender \& Partner Relationship Management** 




 ·       Build and maintain relationships with banks and NBFCs to secure competitive terms and faster turnaround for BlissMoney clients, across both lending and deposit\-side referrals.
 



**2\.5 Cross\-Sell \& Internal Coordination** 




 ·       Work closely with RMs and the Advisory team to identify banking and insurance cross\-sell opportunities within BlissMoney’s existing client base.
 



 ·       Keep the Advisory team informed when a client takes on new business debt, since it affects their overall financial picture.
 



**2\.6 Compliance \& Documentation** 




 ·       
 **DSA Registration:** 
 BlissMoney operates as a facilitator, partnered with banks and NBFC institutions. This role \- or BlissMoney as an entity \- will be registered as a Direct Selling Agent (DSA) with each partner lender.
 



 ·       Follow RBI and FEMA guidelines on loan sourcing, fair practices and cross\-border trade transactions at every stage. Maintain complete, audit\-ready documentation for every case, including export/import documentation where applicable.
 



**3\. What We’re Looking For** 




  






 ·       
 
**Primary Fit:** 
 currently or previously a Relationship Manager in a bank’s Business Banking Group (BBG), Small \& Business Banking (SBB), Mid\-Enterprise Group (MEG), or Corporate/Trade Finance desk \- or an equivalent business banking role at another bank or NBFC.
 




 ·       
 
 Genuine comfort assessing business credit and trade finance requirements \- reading financial statements, understanding working capital cycles, and structuring proposals across both rupee and foreign\-currency facilities.
 




 ·       
 
 Working knowledge of export/import documentation, RBI/FEMA guidelines governing trade finance and cross\-border transactions.
 




 ·       
 
 Comfort managing a full cycle independently \- from sourcing through structuring to closing \- without a separate handover to another closer.
 




 ·       
 
 Existing relationships with banks/NBFCs and business\-owner clients are a strong advantage, given the target candidate profile above.
 




 ·       
 
 Clear, honest communication \- business banking is a trust\-sensitive relationship, and clients need someone who explains terms plainly, not someone who oversells.

The company provides end\-to\-end consultancy for residential and commercial properties across major Indian cities including Pune, Noida, Delhi, Gurugram, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, and is expanding to Dubai. Assettrust supports clients throughout the property lifecycle, from understanding requirements to coordinating with banks, legal advisors, and developers. Its advisory is driven by RERA\-verified options, data\-backed market insights, ethical processes, and personalized client support. The firm focuses on offering sound investment guidance with good ROI and clear, smooth exit clauses for long\-term value.

 The Relationship Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune/Pimpri\-Chinchwad area. This role involves managing and nurturing client relationships, understanding individual real estate needs, and guiding clients through property selection and investment decisions. The Relationship Manager will coordinate with internal teams, developers, banks, and legal partners to ensure a seamless transaction process and timely resolution of client queries. Daily activities include conducting property consultations, sharing market insights, following up on leads, maintaining accurate client records, and supporting clients from initial inquiry through post\-sales service. The role also requires proactive business development, participation in client meetings and site visits, and upholding the company’s standards of ethical and transparent advisory.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong client relationship management, customer service, and interpersonal communication skills to build trust and long\-term engagement.
* Ability to understand real estate requirements, provide investment advisory, and offer basic financial guidance related to ROI and exit strategies.
* Experience in sales or business development, including lead generation, follow\-up, and closure of deals within structured timelines.
* Knowledge of local real estate markets (especially Pune/Pimpri\-Chinchwad), RERA guidelines, and key trends in residential and commercial properties.
* Proficiency in maintaining documentation, using CRM or sales tracking tools, and coordinating with banks, legal advisors, and developers.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; fluency in local languages (e.g., Marathi, Hindi) is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site, conduct property visits, and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously with attention to detail.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Commerce, Real Estate, or a related field; relevant experience in real estate advisory or financial services is preferred.
* High level of integrity, ethical conduct, and a client\-first mindset aligned with transparent, data\-backed advisory practices.

description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

* Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact.
* Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives.
* Uses effective decision\-making approaches such as consultative, command, or consensus.
* Ensures that assumptions and received wisdom are objectively analyzed in decisions.


**Effective Communications** 
 : Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
* Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
* Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
* Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
* Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
* Maintains focus on the topic at hand.


 Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem\-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem\-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem\-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide\-impact problems.


 Organizational Leadership: Knowledge of leadership concepts and ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Employs various group decision\-making methods depending on the situation.
* Promotes efficacy through monitoring, coaching \& motivating subordinates, intervention, etc.
* Translates vision into specific functional or departmental initiatives.
* Uses emotional contagion to affect the mood of group members, tone of group and group processes.
* Uses a normative decision model (with leadership styles and situational variables) to select style.
* Initiates structure: role clarification, setting standards, holding subordinates accountable, etc.


 Customer Interaction: Knowledge of the principles and techniques of communicating with a customer; ability to utilize tools and techniques for customer interaction.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Provides customer support on difficult problems.
* Teaches techniques for transitioning from problem solving to sales opportunities.
* Analyzes the characteristics of threats and selects the proper plan of action for handling them.
* Evaluates techniques for face\-to\-face, telephone and web\-based interactions.
* Advises on methods for identifying leads and procedures for turning them over.
* Implements tactics to de\-escalate problem situations immediately.


 Customer Support Policies, Standards and Procedures: Knowledge of the organization's customer support policies, standards and procedures; ability to guide customers on all company interactions.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****

* Develops quality assurance and monitoring mechanisms.

title: Service Center Manager, India
description:
Job Summary:\*\*
   

  

 FLSmidth \& Co. A/S is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Service Center Manager to lead and oversee all aspects of our service operations in India. This role is crucial for ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction, driving operational efficiency, and contributing to the growth of our aftermarket services business in the region.

* Strong understanding of service processes, field service operations, and customer relationship management.
* Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.

* Proficiency in relevant software applications (e.g., CRM, ERP, service management platforms).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to travel extensively within India and occasionally internationally as required.
* Fluency in English is essential; knowledge of local Indian languages is an advantage.
* Results\-oriented with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.
   

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: GROWTH EXECUTIVE
description:
Growth Executive – Student Engagement \& Memberships
   

  

* Reports to the Success Manager


 We're hiring someone whose whole job is to bring people back.
   

  

 Every fitness company talks about new sign\-ups. Fewer talk about the student who trained hard for four months, then life happened — a project, a move, a bad week — and hasn't logged in since.
   

  

 That student is who this role is for.
   

  

 Why this role exists
   

  

 In 2026, our growth is driven as much by the students already with us as by new sign\-ups. Attendance, re\-activation and renewals are where the next chapter is won.
   

  

 You'll design comeback campaigns for students who've gone quiet, work with our coaches to understand why people drop off, own renewals end to end, and make sure the membership experience — plan changes, payments, the lot — feels seamless.
   

  

 It's a role for someone who can invent a campaign on Monday and cheerfully chase a pending payment on Tuesday. Creative and operationally disciplined. Warm on the phone, sharp in the spreadsheet.
   

  

 You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our coaching team, because engagement problems are rarely just data problems. They're human ones.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

 Engagement \& re\-activation
   

  

* Plan and run engagement campaigns for inactive, low\-attendance and at\-risk students

 Memberships \& renewals

* Support membership growth through renewals and relevant cross\-sell and up\-sell conversations — consultative, never transactional
* Own renewal payment follow\-ups end to end. This is a critical part of the role


 Data \& reporting
   

  

* Track and analyse engagement, attendance and membership data to support decisions
* Maintain accurate membership and engagement records in our CRM
* Produce regular reports on engagement, renewals and revenue against quarterly targets


 How you'll work
   

  

* Use CRM tools and Google Workspace to track every effort — nothing lives only in your head
* Look for the automation, then keep the human touch on top of it
* Bring a growth mindset and a start\-up mentality


 What we need from you
   

  

* 2\+ years in customer success, account management, community management, inside sales or a closely related role. Exceptional freshers with the right temperament are welcome to apply
* Strong English communication, verbal and written. You'll write campaign copy and have renewal conversations on the same day
* Comfort owning payment and renewal follow\-ups — persistent, organised, and never awkward about it
* High proficiency with Google Workspace / MS Office, and hands\-on experience with an online CRM
* Ability to read data and turn it into an action, not just a chart
* Creative thinking paired with operational discipline — you can invent a campaign and also run the checklist that ships it
* A calm, patient, empathetic manner with students. Many of the people you'll speak to left because life got hard
* Based in Chennai and able to work on\-site with the coaching team


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience in a B2C, subscription or membership\-led business
* Background in fitness, sports, wellness or education
* Hands\-on with marketing automation or CRM workflow building — WhatsApp or email journeys, lifecycle campaigns
* Spreadsheets beyond the basics — pivots, cohort views, retention curves
* A training practice of your own. It helps you speak our students' language


 Your first 90 days
   

  

 First 30 days You know our membership plans, CRM and student segments cold. You've run your first re\-activation outreach list and sat in on classes with the coaching team. By day 60 You own the renewals follow\-up cycle independently. A first comeback campaign is designed, shipped and measured. By day 90 You're reporting engagement, renewals and revenue on a regular cadence, and you've brought a measurable lift in attendance or renewal rate on at least one student segment.
   

  

 What you get
   

  

* A balanced, respectful work culture that respects your life outside work
* Free membership at The Quad — train with coaches who've transformed thousands of lives
* Health insurance, annual health checkups and wellness support
* Industry\-standard salaries and a generous leave policy
* The chance to positively affect someone's health every single day


 How to apply
   

  

 Use the form below. Along with your details, send us a short note on a time you brought a lapsed customer, member or student back. That note matters more to us than a cover letter.
   

  

 We read every application, and you'll hear from us either way.
   

  

 The Quad is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on capability, character and fit with how we coach.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.
   

  

 See All Open Roles

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
* To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period.
* EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis.
* For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
* At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
   

  

 All in to shape the future with confidence.
   

  

 EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.

**About Us**
 Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. **What Makes This Role Great**
 Reporting directly to the Manager of Professional Services, Training \& Onboarding (India), you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for net\-new and existing Tekla Structures accounts across India. You will have full ownership over discovery meetings, workflow customization, and client success roadmaps. Working at the intersection of sales, customer support, and global product development, you will play a central role in conveying real\-world customer feedback directly back to core engineering teams to influence future software capabilities.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Onboarding Execution: Lead full\-lifecycle software onboarding and implementation programs for new and existing clients utilizing Tekla Structures (Steel and Concrete configurations).
* Workflow Discovery \& Problem Solving: Conduct deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to analyze client requirements, troubleshoot output customization challenges, and engineer tailored structural detailing workflows.
* Implementation Collateral \& Best Practices: Develop high\-grade onboarding materials, system configurations, and best\-practice guidelines that empower clients to adopt optimal structural detailing standards.
* Project Delivery \& Client Tracking: Help clients establish realistic deployment milestones, deliver ongoing technical guidance to protect timelines, and meticulously track project deliverables and engagement logs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Value Advocacy: Serve as the primary onboarding anchor across Sales, Support, and Product Development teams, while actively presenting the value of Professional Services to prospective clients.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Tekla Structures Deep\-Dive Expertise: 4–5 years of direct, hands\-on experience using Tekla Structures across Steel and Concrete modules.
* Domain \& Industry Experience: 6–7 years of hands\-on structural detailing and design experience with strong domain mastery in structural steel and reinforced concrete workflows.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Communication \& Engagement: Fluent written and spoken English with exceptional interpersonal skills to command credibility across client C\-suites and job\-site engineering teams.
* Independent Execution: Strong diagnostic capability to troubleshoot software issues independently, manage tight schedules, and drive project success with minimal supervision.


**Bonus Points For**
* Multilingual Capability: Fluency in spoken Hindi to engage effectively across diverse regional client bases in India.
* Global Design Codes: Direct experience executing structural detailing projects according to international engineering codes and standards.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Highly organized, detail\-oriented approach with an eagerness to learn complementary Trimble software products.


**Logistics**
